verdict.rationale: Deepgram is an API-first product. Its documented public API covers REST transcription (POST /v1/listen), a WebSocket voice agent endpoint, callbacks and JWT auth, with official SDKs in five languages. A probe confirmed a published OpenAPI spec and agent-oriented llms.txt docs. Independent users report using the API in production and building their own wrapper for it; an old 2018 report of broken docs links does not contradict the current, verified documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
